clusters.canonical_name: Maintain comfortable indoor temperature where and when the home is occupied
clusters.objective: Keep indoor temperature within the occupant's comfortable range according to presence, time of day, and room use, without manual intervention.
clusters.lifecycle: recurring, event- and schedule-conditioned (daily wake times, weekday occupancy patterns, bathroom use)
clusters.meaningful_failure: occupant discomfort from a cold or otherwise uncomfortable indoor space (e.g., waking to a cold house, unheated bathroom)
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit authorization to adjust heating/cooling automatically on schedule, occupancy, or temperature conditions
clusters.rationale: Direct path unavailable packet-wide: no unit is rated strongly_implies or entails by both coders (all compatible_only). Convergent path met: three independent demand owners (Kirsten-home, mattioli-user-11, mattioli-user-29) across two study clusters express the same maintained outcome of occupied-space thermal comfort; aggregate evidence supports an identifiable beneficiary (self/household), recurring event/schedule-conditioned scope, accepted delegation to automation, explicit action authorization, and a meaningful failure of discomfort. All three demand owners are human-authored records (diary or participant rule), not mechanism-only/default/vendor records. Only the heating facet of the compound rule userneeds_u11_r066 and the temperature facet of the jointly managed wake rule userneeds_u29_r173 count toward this cluster; each unit counts once toward the threshold.
clusters.boundary_notes: userneeds_u29_r173 is jointly managed with the single-owner wake-up routine (excluded group E1, userneeds_u29_r169-r174), whose abort rules r172/r174 couple the air conditioner to wake state; the waking-escalation outcome itself is not merged here. Not merged with shower-music ambiance (userneeds_u11_r065) despite shared bathroom context. Zone instances (whole home, bathroom, bedroom) are unified by maintained outcome, not by room or device. Pre-wake conditioning is treated as thermal comfort delivered at wake time, not as part of the waking-escalation objective.

clusters.objective: Detect, record, and alert on unauthorized presence or access at the home while occupants are away or a space is unoccupied, capturing and sending camera evidence, and admitting entry only for authorized people or vehicles.
clusters.lifecycle: event_conditioned and recurring during nights and absences; a persistent standing concern rather than a one-shot convenience
clusters.meaningful_failure: security_failure: an unauthorized person or vehicle enters, or presence occurs, without detection, recording, or alerting the occupant
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: evidence authorizes arming alarm sensors, capturing and sending security camera frames/footage, and automated gate access control
clusters.proposed_path: Convergent within one study cluster: three independent demand owners (mattioli-user-01, mattioli-user-10, mattioli-user-19) express the same maintained outcome, but cross-study confirmation and a direct standing-responsibility anchor are absent.
clusters.rationale: Three independent users authored hypothetical rules converging on detecting unauthorized presence and controlling who/what enters the home: alarm sensors arm when the kitchen is vacated (u01_r003 security facet), doorbell visitors are captured and sent when the user is away (u10_r058), garden movement at night triggers outside lights and camera footage (u10_r061), and the garage gate opens only for recognized vehicles (u19_r114). Both coders rate all four units compatible_only, so the direct admission path is unavailable; the three-owner convergence within a single study cluster supports candidate status but not admission.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with night-time passage illumination for occupants (practicaltap_p8, u28_r165 in X12), which serves safe movement rather than intruder detection; not merged with post-parking garage closure and arrival lighting (u01_r006 in X4), which is a convenience/closure action after arrival rather than access authorization; u01_r003 is a split conjunction whose light-off (energy) facet is assigned to the vacancy_energy_reduction excluded group.
clusters.coding_disagreements: Both coders rate all four units compatible_only (no strongly_implies/entails); luna assigns beneficiary household for u10_r058/u10_r061 while kimi assigns self; luna rates u01_r003 failure_meaning security_failure while kimi rates it unknown; kimi proposes candidate responsibilities for u10_r058, u10_r061, and u19_r114 where luna records none.

clusters.objective: Keep essential household consumables and replaceable components available by detecting depletion or failure and triggering an order, shopping-list entry, or refill alert before or shortly after exhaustion.
clusters.lifecycle: event_conditioned and recurring as stock depletes or components fail
clusters.meaningful_failure: consumable or component runs out and the household is left without the needed item (heating fuel, beer, machine water, working light bulb) until someone notices and restocks
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: evidence authorizes automated ordering from Amazon, adding items to a Google Home shopping list, sending notifications, and turning on a low-level indicator
clusters.proposed_path: Convergent within one study cluster: three independent demand owners (mattioli-user-10, mattioli-user-19, mattioli-user-28) express the same maintained outcome, but cross-study confirmation and a direct standing-responsibility anchor are absent.
clusters.rationale: Three independent users authored rules that keep stocks available: order a replacement bulb when one is not working (u10_r057), send an automatic 'Tank to Refill' notification when pellet weight is low (u19_r109), add beer refill to the shopping list and notify when reserve stock is low (u19_r112), and signal low coffee-machine water level (u28_r163). All units are compatible_only for both coders, so the direct path is unavailable; convergence is confined to one study cluster, so only candidate status is supported.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with appliance-completion notification (u10_r056 in X6), which reports a finished task rather than depleted stock; not merged with garden watering (u28_r166 in X13) or pet care (X8), which maintain living things rather than stock; u28_r163 is the weakest member because its mechanism is only a light-on indicator, and excluding it would drop the cluster to two demand owners.
clusters.coding_disagreements: Both coders rate all four units compatible_only; beneficiary differs by coder on u10_r057 (luna self, kimi household), u19_r109 (luna household, kimi self), and u28_r163 (luna unknown, kimi self); failure_meaning differs on u28_r163 (luna discomfort, kimi inconvenience) and u10_r057 (luna unknown, kimi inconvenience); kimi alone proposes candidate responsibilities for all four units.
